about: Which agent takes which kind of work, and why. Plays are checked against every request; the play with the most matching terms wins. Order breaks ties, so specific plays come first. `council` lists agents worth asking together when one view is not enough. `note` is shown whenever the play matches, even if another play wins.

plays.label: Your connected apps
plays.why: Claude is the only agent wired to your MCP connectors (Shopify, Klaviyo, Gmail, Slack, Drive and the rest).
plays.note: Touches your connected apps. Those connectors live in Claude Code / claude.ai, not in this API call: run it there for live data.

plays.label: Hands-on task (on a Mac)
plays.why: Work that needs hands on a computer: files, a signed-in browser, downloads, exports. A Mac's own Claude Code does it on your subscription and reports back.

plays.label: Fact check
plays.why: Perplexity checks against live sources and cites them. A second agent catches what one search misses.

plays.label: Live research
plays.why: Perplexity searches the web for every answer and returns clickable sources. The others answer from what they were trained on unless they search.

plays.label: Social pulse
plays.why: Grok reads X in real time, so it knows what people are saying now and how they feel about it.

plays.label: Facebook / Instagram
plays.why: Muse is Meta's own agent, built around Facebook, Instagram and Reels formats.

plays.label: Images and visuals
plays.why: ChatGPT makes the image itself (OpenAI's image model) and shows it here; Claude cannot make pictures. Say what to change and ask again to redo it.

plays.label: Ideas and hooks
plays.why: For ideas, range beats any single model. Each agent pulls in a different direction, and Claude picks the strongest.

plays.label: Strategy and decisions
plays.why: Claude is the lead for judgment calls. For bigger decisions a council adds a second opinion and current facts, and Claude weighs them.

plays.label: Code and automation
plays.why: Claude is the strongest coder of the group and runs Claude Code on your Macs.

plays.label: Numbers and analysis
plays.why: Claude reasons carefully through numbers and says what it is unsure of. ChatGPT is a good second check on calculations.

plays.label: Long documents
plays.why: Claude reads very long documents in one go and quotes them accurately.

plays.label: Writing
plays.why: Claude writes in a natural voice and follows a brief closely.

plays.label: General
plays.why: No specialist fits, so the lead agent takes it.
